doc: Row means grouped in 7-degree latitude bands (edges arange(-90, 90 + band, band), band k holds rows with a <= lat < b, lat = degrees of the row center); centers are the band midpoints. A band that does not divide 180: edges run -90..92, so the last band extends past the pole (26 bands). Centers are float64 closed-form (1e-9). The profile is a mean of float32 rows (float32 pairwise accumulation, stored dtype follows the image): float32 tolerance, measured 8e-8 absolute (1.3e-7 relative) against the same rows promoted to float64. An empty band is NaN (numpy warns).
